Notice to Students and Staff
Effective immediately, breakfast is no longer being served in the
dining hall. However, coffee, tea, and pastries will continue to be
available at the Campus Café, including vegetarian, vegan, and
gluten-free options.
For dietary needs questions, speak with café staff.
To provide feedback, contact Dining Services.
